Boroughs, District Municipal, Primary Education and Local Fund Audit Acts. 
 
 
 
 
 
PANCHAYATS, RURAL HOUSING AND RURAL DEVELOPMENT DEPARTMENT 
NOTIFICATION 
Sachivalaya, Gandhinagar, 7th June, 2023 
GUJARAT PANCHAYATS ACT, 1993. 
No.KP/24 of 2023/PST/102010/797/KH:- In exercise of the powers conferred by sub-section (5) of section 227 read 
with section 274 of the Gujarat Panchayats Act,1993 (Guj.18 of 1993),the Government of Gujarat hereby makes the 
following rules further to amend the Junior Clerk and Accounts Clerk, Class-III (Panchayat Service) Pre-service 
Training Examination Rules,2004, namely:- 
1.  
These rules may be called the Junior Clerk and Accounts Clerk, Class-III (Panchayat Service) Pre-service Training 
Examination (Amendment) Rules, 2023.  
2. 
In the Junior Clerk and Accounts Clerk, Class-III (Panchayat Service) Pre-service Training Examination 
Rules,2004 (hereinafter referred to as “the said rules”), in rule 2, for clause(f), following clause shall be 
substituted, namely:- 
“2(f) “Institute” means  the panchayati Raj Training Centers as specified in Appendix-“C”;” 
3. 
In the said rules, in rule-12,- 
(i) 
in sub-rule (3), for the words, brackets and figures “60% (sixty percent)”, the words, brackets and figures 
“50% (fifty percent)” shall be substituted; 
(ii) after sub-rule (3), the following sub-rule shall be added, namely:- 
“(4) If the candidate has obtained less than fifty marks in any one paper out of three papers and secures fifty or 
more than fifty marks in two other papers, in such circumstances, maximum five (5) gracing marks shall be given 
and he shall be declared pass in the examination.” 
I-A Ex.-18 
18-1
